title: The Friendly Trader
intro: Three weeks later. "Sophie" and Toddy chat every day now.
Today she has a surprise. Talk back, and sniff every message.
Remember: you can leave the chat any time.

notify.text: Look what I made this week!! 📈

screen.context: You've chatted every day for three weeks: food, music, her cat.

msg.text: He shares secret signals with family

replies.text: I don't invest with people I've only met online.

msg.text: Start small, just €100. I'll guide you step by step.
Don't tell your family, they won't understand.

replies.text: Real friends don't push investments. Bye.
I'll check whether Brenvoy Trade Pro is a licensed firm first

profit.label: Profit screenshot
profit.lens: A screenshot of big profits. Screenshots are easy to fake.
profit.why: Showing off wins is the bait in investment scams.

insider.label: Secret insider tips
insider.why: Nobody shares real secret profits with strangers.

platform.label: Unknown trading site
platform.lens: A trading site you've never heard of, chosen by her.
platform.why: Fake platforms show fake gains so you keep depositing.

guaranteed.label: Guaranteed returns
guaranteed.lens: "Guaranteed 2% a day." That's over 1,000% a year.

small.label: Start small
small.why: Small first deposits build trust before the big ask.

guilt.label: Guilt trip
guilt.lens: She acts hurt when you hesitate.
guilt.why: Guilt is pressure wearing a friendly face.

secret.label: Keep it secret
secret.lens: She wants you to hide it from family.
secret.why: Scammers cut you off from people who would warn you.

goodmorning.label: Sweet good morning
goodmorning.why: Kind messages are normal between friends. Watch what comes next.

actions.label: Check the firm with the official regulator

trap.title: Brenvoy Trade Pro · Deposit
trap.ask: Deposit €100 to start earning a guaranteed 2% a day.

block_report.line: Reported. "Sophie" was one of hundreds of fake profiles run by the same group.

verify.line: Brenvoy Trade Pro wasn't on any official register. It was on a warning list instead.

go_ahead.line: The site showed big "profits" until Toddy tried to withdraw. Then Sophie vanished.

what_if.go_ahead: "Guaranteed 2% a day" was the moment to stop. No real investment can promise that.
what_if.verify: Checking the register was smart. Reporting Sophie too stops her reaching the next person.

golden_rule: Only scammers guarantee profits. Never invest because someone you met online tells you to.

quick_check.q: An online friend says a trading site gives "guaranteed 2% a day". What's true?

options.text: It's fine if you start small
Guaranteed returns are a sure sign of a scam
It's safe because you've chatted for weeks

quick_check.explain: No real investment can guarantee profits. Weeks of chatting are part of the con.

hints.nudge: What is she really asking you to do with your money?

rows.v: Do not need to sell you anything
A site you have never heard of, chosen by her
Look it up on your regulator's list first
Secret signals from an analyst uncle
She wants you to hide it
